suite: Roadside mini games, real keys (sidescroller 73870de, QAJev e07964d)
about: Each of the six roadside mini games played to its verdict with real key presses, following its own HOW TO PLAY card, reacting to every cue a human 0.3 s after it shows. Each match logs its frame rate and game time against real time; an Arm Wrestle or Claw match counts only at 50 fps or more with game time at least 0.95 of real time, else that test is harness.

scenarios.name: arm wrestle: follow the card
scenarios.about: Following the card (steady alternation at 7 a second, plus holding the flash key 0.3 s after it shows) beats Granny within six matches, and every flash answered at human speed turns into a steal.

scenarios.name: arm wrestle: mashing alone
scenarios.about: Alternating without ever holding the flash key loses: the card's trick is what wins.

scenarios.name: claw: drop on the glint
scenarios.about: Dropping on the glint, as the card says, wins the toy at human reaction speed (0.3 s after the glint, at the moment the claw is over the toy).

scenarios.name: claw: drop without the glint
scenarios.about: A drop over the toy without the glint goes limp and loses: the glint is what wins.

scenarios.name: karaoke: the lane and the spark card
scenarios.about: The lane and the spark card are enough to play: each note's key pressed as it reaches the line, the dark notes from the card. Reports the numbers; José judges the feel.

scenarios.name: poker: call the cheat, then show
scenarios.about: Calling hand 1's cheat 0.3 s after it shows wins that hand, and SHOW ends every hand.

scenarios.name: shells: three in a row
scenarios.about: Three rounds in a row, as the card now says: one wrong cup ends it; round 3's cheat is caught by ACCUSE and naming it.

scenarios.name: critter clash: the right type
scenarios.about: Picking the type that beats theirs (dog > cat > bird > dog) does double damage, as the card says.
